title: Everspin Introduces UNISYST MRAM to Unify Code and Data in Embedded Systems
summary: Everspin Technologies’ UNISYST MRAM platform introduces a unified approach to embedded memory by consolidating code execution and data storage into a single non-volatile device. Targeting NOR flash limitations in high-growth areas like edge AI and industrial computing, it extends MRAM into higher-density applications with minimal system redesign.Read more: https://www.eedesignit.com/everspin-introduces-unisyst-mram-to-unify-code-and-data-in-embedded-systems/
body_markdown:
Everspin Technologies’ UNISYST MRAM platform introduces a unified approach to embedded memory by consolidating code execution and data storage into a single non-volatile device. Targeting NOR flash limitations in high-growth areas like edge AI and industrial computing, it extends MRAM into higher-density applications with minimal system redesign.


Read more: https://www.eedesignit.com/everspin-introduces-unisyst-mram-to-unify-code-and-data-in-embedded-systems/
